note: A constructed fixture. What it copies from reality is the shape of a civic platform's HTML: substance
in a table, a hyperlink in the middle of a sentence, and curly punctuation from a word processor.
The hyperlink is the point. Text extraction inserts a separator at every inline element boundary, so
the sentence containing it comes out with a space before the following comma. A quote spanning that
boundary verifies only because whitespace before punctuation is treated as markup rather than content.
That rule was added after real citations failed on it, and this fixture is what stops it regressing.

_why_this_row_is_hard: A staff report is not a decision. The outcome is pending, the row is censored, and decided_on is
null, even though the document contains the word denial in bold. What the document records is a
recommendation, and staff_recommendation is where it goes.
The relief is a special use permit on a parcel already zoned for the use, which is the discretionary
case: every technical standard is met and the body may still refuse. by_right is false.
A filing date and a hearing date are both present and are different fields.
conditions: Relocation of the buildable area to achieve the 2,000 foot setback.
A groundwater impact study prepared by a licensed hydrogeologist, filed before site plan approval.
A noise study demonstrating compliance with 55 dBA at the property line.

evidence.quote: For the reasons above, staff recommends denial .
The use is permitted in M-1 only by special use permit, so the Board may lawfully refuse it even where every dimensional standard is met.

_why_this_matters: These are the numbers the feature layer needs, and the reason extraction into a schema beats a summary.
A summary would say the site does not meet the setback. A structured extraction says it is short by 550
feet, which is a continuous value the model can use and a memo can quote.

evidence.quote: the parcel lies 1,450 feet from the nearest residentially zoned property, which is 550 feet short of the 2,000 foot setback established by the Data Centre Overlay District , adopted 14 September 2025.
the county has denied three of the last four applications of this type

note: The first quote is the one that spans a hyperlink. In the extracted text there is a space before the
comma after District, because that is where the anchor closed. The quote is written here without the
space, the way a person transcribing it would, and it verifies because whitespace before punctuation

must_not_extract.why: The word denial in bold is a recommendation, not an outcome. Recording it as a denial puts a decision in the record on a date no decision was made, and the body may still approve.
The conditions are offered only if the Board is inclined to approve. They are not conditions of an approval that happened.
The overlay district is referenced, not adopted here. It was adopted in a different document on a different date, and extracting it again would create a duplicate instrument with the wrong source.
